tension.howWorldTensionWorksHelp: Tension is a shared 0 to 100 measure. Tests, war declarations, and crisis outcomes move it immediately. Each turn it moves toward a pressure floor set by the Vietnam ladder, active crises, the wars on this board, and the world nuclear stockpile. Tension alone can reach DEFCON 2, but never DEFCON 1.
tension.pressureFloorHelp: One-off spikes fade. These standing pressures do not. The index cannot fall below this floor and cools 8 percent of the remaining gap each turn when it is above it.
tension.warsDetail: {active, plural, one {# active} other {# active}}, {nuclear, plural, one {# nuclear} other {# nuclear}}
tension.warsHelp: Every active war on the Conflicts board pushes the floor by its intensity. Any war with nuclear-armed countries on opposing sides guarantees a crisis-grade floor. Other wars are weighted by intensity.

federationFinances.title: Federation settlement finances
federationFinances.accounting: Amounts use the shared accounting unit. Original bonds retain their issuer and currency.
federationFinances.continuingRisk: Unpaid contributions reduce successor stability and remain payable by that successor. New borrowing belongs to the continuing issuer. Ordinary sovereign payment rules still apply.
federationFinances.risk: Unpaid contributions reduce successor stability. Later contributions repay the overdraft.

federationDecisions.totalRequired: Name every successor. Each allocation must total 100 percent.
federationDecisions.freshVote: Revised terms require a new legislative vote and fresh consent from every successor. Previous approvals do not carry over.

russianConstitution.title: Russian institutional decisions
russianConstitution.separateDecisions: Each institutional change requires its own parliamentary decision. Current officeholders remain until a lawful successor can take office.
russianConstitution.presidencyHelp: Authorize a direct presidential election without replacing the current legislature.
russianConstitution.assemblyHelp: Authorize elections for a 450-seat State Duma and 178-seat Federation Council without establishing a presidency.
russianConstitution.threshold: Approval requires two-thirds of the full chamber capacity of {seats} seats. Vacancies and abstentions do not reduce the threshold.
russianConstitution.loadError: Institutional decisions could not be loaded.
russianConstitution.openError: The institutional bill could not be opened.

reasons.before-date: The historical decision date has not arrived.
reasons.awaiting-succession: A ratified Soviet succession settlement is required first.
reasons.already-authorized: This institutional decision has already been authorized.
reasons.no-legislature: No active legislature can authorize this decision.
reasons.other-era: This decision is unavailable in this era.
reasons.awaiting-assembly: A seated Federal Assembly is required before changing Council formation.

russianConstitution.regionalHeadsHelp: Let the executive head and legislative chair of each federal subject represent their region in the Council.
russianConstitution.regionalDelegatesHelp: Let regional executive and legislative authorities appoint separate Council representatives, whose mandates follow the appointing authority.
russianConstitution.ordinaryThreshold: Each chamber must approve by a majority of its full capacity. The lower chamber has {seats} seats. Ordinary enactment and veto rules still apply.

hungarianElectoralReform.title: Hungarian 1994 electoral amendment
hungarianElectoralReform.help: Parliament may raise the list threshold from more than four percent to more than five percent, and allow three times the list seat capacity in filed nominees. The date opens the decision. Existing general ballots keep their rules.
hungarianElectoralReform.threshold: More than half the Assembly must attend; two-thirds of attending deputies must approve. Abstentions count as attendance.
hungarianElectoralReform.loadError: Could not load the electoral decision.
hungarianElectoralReform.openError: Could not open the electoral bill. Your office or the decision may have changed.
hungarianElectoralReform.viewBill: View and vote on the bill

reasons.other-era: This decision is available in a 1991 world.
reasons.modern-law-in-force: The modern Assembly already has its electoral settlement.
reasons.no-legislature: The current political settlement has no eligible parliamentary Assembly.

hungarianElectoralReform.npcReason: The NPC government proposed this amendment because its party holds more than five percent of Assembly seats. Parliament still decides.
hungarianElectoralReform.legislatorReason: A deputy introduced this amendment for a parliamentary vote.
